```kotlin
package com.cowave.search.inbound_adapter.handler.listener
import com.commerce.proxy.shopping.product.infrastructure.consumer.dto.ProductCdcEnvelope
import com.cowave.search.application.index.service.ProductIndexApplicationService
import com.cowave.search.inbound_adapter.handler.ConsumerCallbackManager
import com.cowave.search.inbound_adapter.handler.mapper.toChangedProductData
import com.cowave.shared.utils.logger
import org.apache.avro.specific.SpecificRecord
import org.apache.kafka.clients.consumer.Consumer
import org.apache.kafka.clients.consumer.ConsumerRecord
import org.springframework.kafka.listener.BatchAcknowledgingConsumerAwareMessageListener
import org.springframework.kafka.support.Acknowledgment

class ProductDynamicIndexListener(
    private val productIndexApplicationService: ProductIndexApplicationService,
    groupId: String,
    consumerCallbackManager: ConsumerCallbackManager,
) : FlinkCdcBatchListener(groupId, consumerCallbackManager),
    BatchAcknowledgingConsumerAwareMessageListener<SpecificRecord, SpecificRecord> {
    private val logger by logger()

    override fun onMessage(
        data: List<ConsumerRecord<SpecificRecord, SpecificRecord>>,
        acknowledgment: Acknowledgment?,
        consumer: Consumer<*, *>,
    ) {
        runCatching {
            val changedDocuments =
                data
                    .filter { record ->
                        val envelope = record.value() as ProductCdcEnvelope
                        val product = envelope.after ?: envelope.before
                        product != null && product.categoryId > 0
                    }.map { it.toChangedProductData() }

            productIndexApplicationService.indexProducts(changedDocuments)
        }.onSuccess {
            acknowledgment?.acknowledge()
            rewindIfNeeded()
        }.onFailure { ex ->
            logger.error(ex) { "Failed to index products" }
        }.getOrThrow()
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package com.cowave.search.application.index.service

import com.cowave.search.application.index.mapper.LegacySyncMapper
import com.cowave.search.application.index.repository.LegacySyncRepository
import com.cowave.search.domain.index.dto.ChangedData
import com.cowave.search.domain.index.dto.LegacyProductData
import com.cowave.search.domain.index.enums.Operation
import com.cowave.search.domain.proxy.category.CategoryHierarchyResolver
import com.cowave.search.domain.proxy.mall.MallService
import com.cowave.shared.utils.logger
import org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.condition.ConditionalOnProperty
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service

@Service
@ConditionalOnProperty(name = ["legacy-sync.enabled"], havingValue = "true", matchIfMissing = true)
class LegacySyncApplicationService(
    private val legacySyncRepository: LegacySyncRepository,
    private val categoryHierarchyResolver: CategoryHierarchyResolver,
    private val mallService: MallService,
) {
    private val logger by logger()

    fun syncToLegacy(changedData: List<ChangedData<LegacyProductData>>) {
        if (changedData.isEmpty()) return

        // 1. 필요한 카테고리/몰 ID 수집
        val categoryIds = changedData.mapNotNull { it.afterData?.categoryId }.distinct()
        val mallIds = changedData.mapNotNull { it.afterData?.mallId }.distinct()

        // 2. 의존성 조회
        val categories = if (categoryIds.isNotEmpty()) categoryHierarchyResolver.resolve(categoryIds) else emptyMap()
        val malls = if (mallIds.isNotEmpty()) mallService.getMalls(mallIds).associateBy { it.mallId } else emptyMap()

        // 3. 링크/미링크 분기
        val grouped = changedData.groupBy { it.op }

        grouped.forEach { (op, items) ->
            val linked = mutableListOf<com.cowave.search.application.index.dto.LinkedProductRequest>()
            val unlinked = mutableListOf<com.cowave.search.application.index.dto.UnlinkedProductRequest>()

            items.forEach { item ->
                val data = if (op == Operation.DELETE) item.beforeData else item.afterData
                if (data == null) {
                    logger.warn { "Legacy sync skipped: no data for product id=${item.id}, op=$op" }
                    return@forEach
                }

                val category = categories[data.categoryId]
                val mall = malls[data.mallId]

                if (data.isCatalogMatch || op == Operation.DELETE) {
                    linked.add(LegacySyncMapper.toLinkedRequest(data, mall))
                } else {
                    unlinked.add(LegacySyncMapper.toUnlinkedRequest(data, category, mall))
                }
            }

            if (linked.isNotEmpty()) {
                legacySyncRepository.pushLinkedProducts(linked, op)
            }
            if (unlinked.isNotEmpty()) {
                legacySyncRepository.pushUnlinkedProducts(unlinked, op)
            }
        }
    }
}
```

기존 `ProductDynamicIndexListener.kt`를 수정:

```kotlin
class ProductDynamicIndexListener(
    private val productIndexApplicationService: ProductIndexApplicationService,
    private val legacySyncApplicationService: LegacySyncApplicationService?,  // nullable for feature toggle
    groupId: String,
    consumerCallbackManager: ConsumerCallbackManager,
) : FlinkCdcBatchListener(groupId, consumerCallbackManager),
    BatchAcknowledgingConsumerAwareMessageListener<SpecificRecord, SpecificRecord> {
    private val logger by logger()

    override fun onMessage(
        data: List<ConsumerRecord<SpecificRecord, SpecificRecord>>,
        acknowledgment: Acknowledgment?,
        consumer: Consumer<*, *>,
    ) {
        runCatching {
            val filteredData = data.filter { record ->
                val envelope = record.value() as ProductCdcEnvelope
                val product = envelope.after ?: envelope.before
                product != null && product.categoryId > 0
            }

            val changedDocuments = filteredData.map { it.toChangedProductData() }

            if (legacySyncApplicationService != null) {
                val legacyDocuments = filteredData.map { it.toLegacyProductData() }
                runBlocking(Dispatchers.IO) {
                    val esJob = async { productIndexApplicationService.indexProducts(changedDocuments) }
                    val legacyJob = async {
                        runCatching { legacySyncApplicationService.syncToLegacy(legacyDocuments) }
                            .onFailure { logger.error(it) { "Legacy sync failed" } }
                    }
                    esJob.await()
                    legacyJob.await()
                }
            } else {
                productIndexApplicationService.indexProducts(changedDocuments)
            }
        }.onSuccess {
            acknowledgment?.acknowledge()
            rewindIfNeeded()
        }.onFailure { ex ->
            logger.error(ex) { "Failed to index products" }
        }.getOrThrow()
    }
}
```
